requirement_feedback.original_text: The System shall be able to move a point mass from an origin point to a fixed destination point. Note 1: The path is notional; the actual path is to be determined. Note 2: Assume that a link between the system output and the point mass will be designed separately (by someone else) and will match the needs of your design. Note 3: The origin point is (X, Y, Z) = (0 mm, 0 mm, 101.6 mm) or [0”, 0”, 4”]. Note 4: The destination point is (X, Y, Z) = (71.84 mm, 0 mm, -71.84 mm) or [2.82”, 0”, -2.82”].
